grandOrrery.synopsis: My grand orrery turns from sun to moon to usefulness. Franklin's measure is Cleanliness: clear standing water, dead leaves, dirty tools, and small disorder before it grows teeth. Therefore the household should finish mercy work early, shade the vulnerable, and waste no water.

tarot.reading: I observe the quiet pattern; the garden has not finished speaking.
I tend growth, water, shade, and the beings who depend on them.
I set boundaries: pots, gates, squirrels, time, and heat.
I honor the old practice, then make it useful.
I choose what I am actually willing to care for.
I move with purpose, but I secure the cargo.

2026-06-06.tarotMessage: Household message: The High Priestess asks everyone at Las Jaras to listen before rushing. The Empress says the weather will reward care, shade, and attention to living things. The Lovers warns that the day will reveal what everyone is actually willing to tend. The Chariot brings the blessing of steady movement, secured cargo, and no dramatic shortcuts.
2026-06-06.note: I begin this archive by listening before I command. The heat has opinions, the garden has unfinished speech, and I will let evidence outrank drama.
